meta.name: add-rtk
meta.description: Install rtk token-compression proxy into agent containers. Routes Bash tool calls through rtk for 60–90% token savings on dev commands (git, cargo, pytest, docker, kubectl, etc.).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在容器中安装 rtk 代理以压缩令牌，节省开发命令的令牌消耗
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用 AI 辅助开发且想减少令牌消耗
copy.tagline_en: Install rtk proxy in containers to compress tokens and save on dev commands
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use AI-assisted development and want to reduce token usage

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 每次执行 Bash 终端命令都会先交给 rtk 代理处理,然后才真正执行;git、cargo、pytest 等常见开发命令的 token 消耗会被压缩 60–90%。
howto.when: 按步骤装好并重启目标容器后,每次 Claude 调用 Bash 工具执行命令都会触发,例如你对它说“运行 git status”这类开发命令时。

say.text: 运行 git status,看看仓库状态。
say.note: 这条命令会经 rtk 转发,输出被压缩。

say.text: 跑一下 cargo test,只汇报失败的用例。
say.note: 会触发 Bash,rtk 对输出做压缩。

say.text: 执行 docker ps,列出正在运行的容器。
say.note: docker 命令受支持,会走 rtk 代理。

howto.what_en: Once installed, every Bash tool call Claude makes is passed through rtk before execution. Common dev commands such as git, cargo, and pytest use 60–90% fewer tokens.
howto.when_en: After installing and restarting the container, every Bash tool call Claude makes triggers rtk, for example when you ask Claude to run git status or any other supported dev command.

say_en.text: Run git status and show me the repository state.
say_en.note: The Bash call is passed through rtk.

say_en.text: Run cargo test and report only the failed cases.
say_en.note: The Bash call triggers rtk and its output is compressed.

say_en.text: Run docker ps and list the running containers.
say_en.note: Docker is among the dev commands rtk supports.
